stewards.meta.title: Stewards & decisions
stewards.meta.description: Every stewards' decision in public: reference, driver, penalty, reasoning and clip. Plus the form for reporting an incident.
stewards.title: Stewards
stewards.lead: Every stewards' decision is public – with reasoning, clip and reference number. Here you will find every verdict, and you can report an incident yourself.
stewards.openDeadline.title: Protest window open
stewards.register.title: All decisions
stewards.register.emptyText: As soon as the stewards have decided, every verdict will appear here with its reasoning.
stewards.penalty.grid: {n}-place grid drop at the next race
stewards.procedure.title: How the stewards work
stewards.procedure.lead: The procedure is set out in the rules. The essentials at a glance:
stewards.procedure.deadline.title: Deadline
stewards.procedure.deadline.text: You can report an incident up to {hours} hours after the provisional result. The exact closing time is shown for every round. After that, only league management accepts reports – and only in justified exceptional cases.
stewards.procedure.evidence.title: Video evidence
stewards.procedure.evidence.text: No clip, no review: link a video from YouTube, Twitch, Medal, Streamable, Xbox or PlayStation with a timestamp. The stewards may also use any other material available.
stewards.procedure.conflict.title: Conflicts of interest
stewards.procedure.conflict.text: Anyone involved in an incident does not take part in the decision – the website enforces this. Depending on the season, every decision needs two stewards' votes.
stewards.procedure.publication.title: Publication
stewards.procedure.publication.text: Every decision appears here with reference number, reasoning and clip, usually within 72 hours after the window closes. Time, position and DSQ penalties are applied to the result automatically.
stewards.decision.metaDescription: {verdict} for {driver} in {round}: reasoning, clip and effect on the result.
stewards.decision.title: Decision {ref}
stewards.decision.translated: Translation – the German version is authoritative.
stewards.decision.effect.title: Effect on the result
stewards.decision.effect.no_action: No effect: the stewards found no breach of the rules, for example a racing incident.
stewards.decision.effect.warning: No effect on the result. The warning is recorded and may lead to harsher penalties if repeated.
stewards.decision.effect.time_penalty: {n} seconds are added to {driver}'s race time. The result and the standings have been recalculated automatically.
stewards.decision.effect.position_penalt: {driver} drops {n} places in the result. The result and the standings have been recalculated automatically.
stewards.decision.effect.grid_penalty_ne: {driver} starts the next race {n} places further back. The result of this round is unchanged.
stewards.decision.effect.dsq: {driver} is removed from the result of this session and scores no points. The drivers behind move up.
stewards.decision.effect.race_ban: {driver} is banned from the next race. The result of this round is unchanged.
stewards.decision.effect.appliesToNext: Applies to the next race of the season.
stewards.decision.effect.currentResult: {driver}'s result in this session (after all penalties):
stewards.report.metaDescription: Report an incident to the stewards – within the protest window and with a clip link.
stewards.report.title: Report an incident
stewards.report.lead: Were you involved in an incident or did you see one? Report it here within the protest window – with a clip link and timestamp.
stewards.report.deadlines.title: Open protest windows
stewards.report.closed.title: No protest window is open right now
stewards.report.closed.text: Reports can only be filed within the protest window after a provisional result. League management only accepts late reports in justified exceptional cases – for example after a technical fault. To do so, contact the admins via a Discord ticket or the contact form.
stewards.report.chooseRound.legend: Which round is your report about?
stewards.report.reporterHint: Any driver who started in this round may file a report.
stewards.report.involvedHint: Select every driver involved – including yourself if you were involved. At least one other driver must be selected.
stewards.report.lapHint: If you know it – usually not needed for qualifying.
stewards.report.clipHint: Required. YouTube, Twitch, Medal, Streamable and share links from Xbox and PlayStation are accepted. The clip must be viewable without logging in.
stewards.report.clipTimestampHint: Where the incident can be seen in the clip, for example 01:23 or 1:02:10.
stewards.report.contactHint: If the stewards have questions, they will contact you on Discord. Your name is not published and is deleted at the end of the season.
stewards.report.abuse.title: Misuse will be penalised
stewards.report.abuse.text: Knowingly false information or manipulated clips are penalised under the penalty catalogue. If in doubt, the stewards will check with you on Discord.
stewards.report.privacy.before: Your report goes to the stewards and to an internal Discord channel. You can find the details in our
stewards.report.success.title: Thank you – your report has been received
stewards.report.success.step1: The stewards check whether your report is complete and arrived within the window.
stewards.report.success.step2: If they have questions, they will contact you on Discord. Please reply within 24 hours.
stewards.report.success.step3: As a rule, the stewards decide within 72 hours after the window closes. Stewards who were involved do not take part.
stewards.report.success.step4: The decision appears in the public register with its reasoning.
